usages.explain: Used with nouns indicating degree to express "because that degree is too high". The clause following it states the obvious result of that cause.

examples.content: あまりの激痛に、思わず叫び声をあげた。
examples.transcription: あまりのげきつうに、おもわずさけびごえをあげた。
examples.mean: The pain was so intense that I couldn't help but scream.

examples.content: 10年ぶりで兄に会ったが、あまりの兄の変化に言葉が出なかった。
examples.transcription: 10ねんぶりであににあったが、あまりのあにのへんかにことばがでなかった。
examples.mean: When I met my brother for the first time in 10 years, I was speechless at how much he had changed.

title: あまりの～に => because the degree is too hight
